get_signals.analysis: PM2.5 at 86 µg/m³ is ~4.8–10.8x baseline (8–18). Three consecutive elevated readings, simultaneous NOx rise, and wind aligned from active freight loading support a real localized emission event rather than isolated sensor error. Trust is moderate-high (80) and corroborating context argues against quarantine.
get_signals.context: Three consecutive elevated readings appeared downwind of active freight loading. The neighboring nitrogen sensor rose simultaneously and wind direction points from the loading apron.
get_signals.response: Declare a localized air-quality incident. Verify with nearby monitors and inspect freight-loading emissions/idle equipment immediately. Increase sampling cadence, log meteorology, and notify site operations and environmental compliance. Quarantine the sensor only if cross-checks fail or calibration/drift anomalies are found.

get_signals.context: Dissolved oxygen remained below the station baseline for forty minutes during an outgoing tide while turbidity increased at the paired harbor sensor.

get_signals.analysis: Reading of 92 m/s vastly exceeds the 1-14 m/s baseline and physically implausible for an upland residential ridge without corroboration from adjacent stations. The instantaneous jump from 6 to 92 m/s within a single interval is inconsistent with atmospheric dynamics. Repeated checksum errors in the diagnostic heartbeat confirm hardware or firmware integrity failure. No neighboring station corroboration eliminates a genuine meteorological event.
get_signals.context: The value jumped from six to ninety-two within one interval without movement in nearby stations, and the diagnostic heartbeat contains repeated checksum errors.
get_signals.response: Immediately quarantine sensor and flag all data from this unit pending physical inspection. Suspend automated alerts triggered by this node to prevent false emergency dispatch. Dispatch technician to Hillcrest Wind Post to inspect anemometer hardware, firmware, and communication stack. Cross-reference calibration logs at the linked repository. Do not restore to operational status until two consecutive clean diagnostic cycles and readings align with adjacent station baselines.

get_inspections.analysis: Elevated PM2.5 levels verified by co-located instrument and linked to active diesel equipment upwind during freight loading. Calibration checks passed, no sensor issues detected.
get_inspections.findings: The inlet was unobstructed and calibration checks passed. A co-located reference instrument confirmed the elevated concentration during loading, and timestamped photographs show active diesel equipment upwind.
get_inspections.plan: Verify the mast inlet and calibration state, collect a co-located reference sample, photograph nearby emission activity, and publish time-aligned raw readings.
